name: Transaction Support for Git Integration & Deployment Pipelines
description: Fabric Warehouse deployments via Git integration and deployment pipelines  execute under a transaction. If any step in a deployment fails, all changes are automatically rolled back — leaving your warehouse in its exact pre-deployment state with no manual cleanup required.**Atomic Deployments** - All changes in a deployment now execute as a single transaction. On success, changes are committed atomically. On failure, the entire deployment is rolled back automatically — no partial state, no manual remediation.**Automatic Rollback on Failure** - If any change in a deployment fails, workflows automatically rolls back all changes made during that deployment. Your warehouse is restored to its prior state instantly, and a clear error message tells you what failed and that the rollback was successful.

result.nameEs: Transacciones en Git integration y deployment pipelines
result.descriptionEs: Los despliegues de Fabric Warehouse mediante Git integration y deployment pipelines se ejecutarán como una sola transacción: si algún paso falla, todos los cambios se revierten automáticamente y el warehouse vuelve a su estado anterior, con un mensaje claro sobre el error.
